    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    t = input[1]
    words = input[3:]

    word_dict = defaultdict(list)
    for word in words:
        word_dict[word.lower()[::-1]].append(word)

    result = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(t):
        found = False
        for j in range(i + 1, len(t) + 1):
            if t[i:j] in word_dict:
                result.append(word_dict[t[i:j]][0])
                i = j
                found = True
                break
        if not found:
            i += 1

    print(" ".join(result))

main()
